verdict.rationale: Omarchy's own docs state the firewall is enabled by default. They say it blocks all incoming traffic except port 22 (ssh) and port 53317 (LocalSend), so a switcher gets it with no manual setup. Support rests on that single first-party statement, and it leaves SSH open by default. missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the firewall is active after install, fuller documentation of the firewall tooling and how to manage or adjust the defaults.
